stem: If \(\sin 32^{\circ} = k\), which of the following is also equal to \(k\)?
solution: The sine of an acute angle equals the cosine of its complement: \(\sin x^{\circ} = \cos(90 - x)^{\circ}\).

explanation.A: Incorrect. \(\sin 58^{\circ} = \cos 32^{\circ}\), not \(\sin 32^{\circ}\); the complement switches sine to cosine.
explanation.B: Incorrect. Sine and cosine of the same acute angle are equal only for \(45^{\circ}\).
explanation.D: Incorrect. Tangent is not the cofunction of sine; \(\tan 58^{\circ}\) is greater than 1, while \(\sin 32^{\circ}\) is less than 1.

verify:
choices = {o: choices[n] for o, n in {'C': 'A', 'B': 'B', 'A': 'C', 'D': 'D'}.items()}; answer = {'A': 'C', 'B': 'B', 'C': 'A', 'D': 'D'}[answer]  # shuffled: original letters
dg=lambda e: e.replace(lambda f: f.func in (sin,cos,tan), lambda f: f.func(f.args[0]*pi/180))
k0=sin(32*pi/180)
assert abs(N(dg(value(choices[answer]))-k0))<1e-12
assert all(abs(N(dg(value(choices[c]))-k0))>1e-3 for c in choices if c!=answer)

checks.note: solver objection reviewed: key confirmed (sin 32 = cos 58)
